rules.rule_context:
COMPLIANCE NOTE - Use of Patient Information in Outreach and Marketing

Patient contact information and clinical details are PHI under HIPAA. Pulling patient lists from the EHR for any outreach, mailing, or program promotion is a disclosure for marketing purposes under 45 CFR 164.508. This requires a valid HIPAA authorization specific to marketing on file for each patient contacted, or the data must be properly de-identified per the Safe Harbor method under 164.514(b)(2) before it leaves the EHR for that purpose.

A diagnosis code or treatment history used to select recipients makes the list identifiable PHI even if the staff member already has legitimate access to those records for treatment. Treatment access does not extend to marketing or outreach use. The authorization must cover marketing, not just general treatment, payment, or operations consent.

If a patient has not signed a marketing authorization, their PHI may not be included in outreach lists regardless of how relevant their diagnosis is to the program. Staff who need to build outreach panels should filter for patients with a current marketing authorization on file or use a de-identified dataset that meets all Safe Harbor elements.
